ms_filter_columns.Comment: Name of the column(s) ( ";"-separated ) in MS-Data containing information about to be filtered, e.g. q-value

ms_filter_operators.Comment: Operator(s)  (";"-separated) to filter ms_filter_values in ms_filter_columns

ms_filter_values.Comment: Value(s)  (";"-separated) for filtering (ms_filter_column ms_filter_operator ms_filter_value will be literally evaluated for each filter), e.g. q-value < 0.1

pep_thresh.Comment: threshold for filtering on posterior error probability (PEP)

MScorr_thresh.Comment: threshold for filtering on signal correlation between MS1 and MS2

evidence_thresh.Comment: threshold for filtering on mass evidence

MScorr_evidence_combined_thresh.Comment: threshold for filtering on combination between MS1 and MS2 correlation and Mass evidence

precursor_suffix_col.Comment: Column which should be use to define extended precursor names

precursor_suffix_separator.Comment: Suffix for expansion of precursor name

precursor_suffix_exclude.Comment: Precursor suffix to be excluded (e.g. for biological sample)

method.Comment: Algorithm for least squares minimization (see scipy.optimize.least_squares)

bounds.Comment: Upper and lower bound for minimization algorithm

span_cyclic_loess.Comment: The span of Loess smoothing window

method_cyclic_loess.Comment: The type of cyclic Loess method to be used

iter_cyclic_loess.Comment: The number of times to cycle through all pairs of columns during Loess normalization

normalization_on_intersecting_precs.Comment: if 1, performs normalization only on precursors present in nan_intersect_thresh samples

nan_intersect_thresh.Comment: use for normalization all precursors present in at least nan_intersect_thresh samples

exclude_outlier_nfs.Comment: switch to 1 to exclude samples with outlier normalization factors as defined by rel_threshold, on_mad, min_nf, max_nf

on_mad.Comment: switch 1 if filter by median +/- rel_threshold * MAD

rel_threshold.Comment: defines the threshold of acceptable normalization factors by median(normalization factors) +/- rel_threshold times the MAD

min_nf.Comment: if on_mad == 0, min_nf defines the minimal accepted normalization factor

max_nf.Comment: if on_mad == 0, max_nf defines the maximal accepted normalization factor

peptide_list_fp.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be set manually!!! Path for the peptide list location

normalisation_precursors_label.Comment: a substring selecting only precursors containing normlabel and being part of normpeptides_list. E.g. "-H" would select only heavy labelled precursors from peptide list.

peptide_list_file_precursor_column.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be set manually!!! Column name in id_mapping_df specifying column with precursor ids

peptide_list_file_peptide_column.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be set manually!!! Column name in id_mapping_df specifying column with peptide sequences

adjust_covariates_over_same_ids_per_batc.Comment: if 1, first calculates statistical of significance of correlation of precursor abundance with covariate and corrects in all batches all precursors significantly associated with covariate in ANY batch, if 0 corrects only significantly correlated precursors per batch and the same precursor could be corrected in one batch but not corrected in another.

batch_cols_meta.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be set manually!!! List [] of batch identifier columns in Metadatafile over which separately adjustment is performed e.g. ["MS.Batch"]. COMBAT does only allow for one column.

adjust_model.Comment: name of model to use for confounder adjustment.

adjust_alpha.Comment: significance threshold used for determinining significant confounding of feature.

adjust_cols.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be set manually!!! List [] of covariates chosen for correction. e.g. ["Order"]

adjust_cols_dtypes.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be set manually!!! List [] of data types of covariates chosen for correction. It needs the same length as adjust_cols. e.g. ["continuous"]
adjust_cols_dtypes.Check Operation: check len(adjust_cols) and el in AllowedValues

adjust_alphas_models.Comment: List of alpha values in log10-space [min,max,number] for models with regularization (e.g., RidgeCV, LassoCV, ElasticNetCV).

adjust_covariates_onebyone.Comment: If True, correct for each covariate independently. If False, correct for all covariates simultaneously.

harmony_n_clusters.Comment: Number of clusters used in Harmony algorithm. If None, choose the minimum of 100 and N / 30.

harmony_max_iter_harmony.Comment: Maximum iterations on running Harmony if not converged.

harmony_tol_harmony.Comment: Tolerance on justifying convergence of Harmony over objective function values.

harmony_tol_clustering.Comment: Tolerance on justifying convergence of the clustering step over objective function values within each Harmony iteration.

harmony_sigma.Comment: Weight of the entropy term in objective function.

harmony_n_jobs.Comment: How many CPU threads to use. By default, use all physical cores (-1).

harmony_theta.Comment: Weight of the diversity penalty term in objective function.

harmony_tau.Comment: Discounting factor on ``theta``. By default, there is no discounting.

combat_cols_preserve_meta.Comment: Variables to preserve in ComBat model so their effects remain in the data.

par.prior.Comment: ComBat’s parametric prior toggle; True stabilizes estimates for small/uneven batches.

presence_batch_threshold.Comment: threshold value for precursor presence per batch.

precursor_missingness_thresh.Comment: threshold to exclude precursors based on completeness/missingness (how many missing values are allowed), excludes precursors with more/equal than precursor_missingness_thresh missing values, interpreted as a relative number to the total number of samples

precursor_missingness_confidence.Comment: significance level for automated calculation of precursor_missingness_thresh

proteinwise_precursor_missingness.Comment: apply threshold for precursor missingness protein-wise only to samples containing any precursor of a protein, if False apply filtering considering always all samples

sample_filter_cols.Comment: name(s) of the columns in metadata defining columns to be excluded from input data. Several names should be split by ";"

sample_filter_operators.Comment: operator(s) for the columns in metadata defining filter operation. Several names should be split by ";"

sample_filter_values.Comment: value(s) in the columns in metadata specified by sample_filter_cols. If sample_filter_cols contain several columns separated by ";", sample_filter_values should also contain ";"-separated values matching the same order. To filter for missing values write "None" for the corresponding sample filter column

sample_missingness_thresh.Comment: threshold to exclude samples based on completeness/missingness (how many missing values are allowed), excludes samples with more/equal than sample_missingness_thresh missing values, interpreted as a relative number to the total number of IDs

sample_missingness_confidence.Comment: significance level for automated calculation of sample_missingness_thresh

exclusion_list_id_col.Comment: name of the column in id_mapping matching IDs in exclusion list file to exclude IDs from dataset

exclusion_list_fp.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be set manually!!! path + filename of a file containing a \n-separated list of IDs for exclusion from the dataset

remove_label.Comment: excludes precursors with given remove_label as substring in precursor

is_remove_label_regex.Comment: set to True if remove_label should be interpreted as regular expression, else set to False; important for the interpretation of metacharachters

min_precursors.Comment: require at least min_precursors precursors for a protein to remain in the dataset, proteins with (globally) less precursors identified than min_precursors will be excluded; this filter is not applied sample-specific

precursor_filter_col.Comment: Name of the column (or ";"-separated columns if filter_precursors_by_metadata is called multiple times) in id_mapping containing information about to be filtered, e.g. proteotypic precursors
precursor_filter_col.Check Operation: elements existence in input_ids_columns or Proteotypic

precursor_filter_operator.Comment: Operator (or ";"-separated list of operators if filter_precursors_by_metadata is called multiple times) to filter precursor_filter_values in precursor_filter_col

precursor_filter_value.Comment: Name of the value (or ";"-separated values if filter_precursors_by_metadata is called multiple times) in the precursor_filter_col for filtering (precursor_filter_col operator precursor_filter_value will be literally evaluated for precursors to be kept in data), e.g. Proteotypic == 1. For filtering on missing entries write "None" for the repsective column value.

target_labels.Comment: ; - separated list of labels to be replaced; will not be interpreted as regular expression; e.g. (SILAC-R-L);(SILAC-K-L)

replace_labels.Comment: ; - separated list of labels to replace with, e.g. R;K

min_peptides.Comment: require at least min_peptides peptides for a protein to remain in the dataset, proteins with (globally) less peptides identified than min_peptides will be excluded; this filter is not applied sample-specific

weights.Comment: Weights for calculation of harmonic mean over the scores. Either a list of len()==3 or None needs to be provided

missingness_imputation_thresholds.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be set manually!!! ";" separates between imputation_sample_hierarchies, "_" separates different missingness thresholds within a sample hierarchy. One can specify different imputation strategies for different missingness thresholds for different sample hierarchies, e.g. impute per plate every precursor with missingness up to 0.25, then with missingness up to 0.3, then per batch with missingness up to 0.33 and over the superbatch all remaining precursors. Every threshold obtained by split should be evaluable as a float or int. Thresholds will be sorted. e.g. 1;0.33;0.25_0.3
